text: Bounded projected-BFGS provider and opt-in nine-start shape policy now match all 80 reference energies; JVM public suite accepts all 60 reference-interior solutions and refuses all 20 boundary solutions, including both original counterexamples. Numerical near-ties explicitly prefer lower projected gradient within 1e-12 scaled energy; final Newton/curvature admission is unchanged. Full provider core 804 JVM/792 JS, AR 155/153, fit 694/637 and scalafimCompileAll pass with the explicit local provider. Gale PR https://github.com/canardlapin/gale/pull/21 is under CI/review; pin and final hosted-provider gates follow merge. Search remains opt-in and expensive (initial 80-cell run 442 seconds); no throughput/scientific or PHRF-33 closure claim.
